questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

32 + 24 × 4 ÷ 16 – 64 = 90
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4671232025562bc3ba9a781319d633acf8cd8e78dc8e96912cd7564a7df4717d.png] 

Option 1) : + and × 

Given equation : 32 + 24 × 4 ÷ 16 – 64 = 90

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 32 × 24 + 4 ÷ 16 - 64 = 90

⇒ 32 × 24 + __**4 ÷ 16**__ - 64 = 90

⇒ __**32 × 24**__ + 0.25 - 64 = 90

⇒ __**768 + 0.25**__ - 64 = 90

⇒ __**768.25 - 64**__ = 90

⇒ 704.25 ≠ 90

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 2) : ÷ and +

Given equation : 32 + 24 × 4 ÷ 16 – 64 = 90

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 32 ÷ 24 × 4 + 16 - 64 = 90

⇒ __**32 ÷ 24**__ × 4 + 16 - 64 = 90

⇒ __**1.333 × 4**__ + 16 - 64 = 90

⇒ __**5.333 + 16**__ - 64 = 90

⇒ __**21.333 - 64**__ = 90

⇒ - 42.666 ≠ 90

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : ÷ and ×

Given equation : 32 + 24 × 4 ÷ 16 – 64 = 90

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 32 + 24 ÷ 4 × 16 - 64 = 90

⇒ 32 + __**24 ÷ 4**__ × 16 - 64 = 90

⇒ 32 + __**6 × 16**__ - 64 = 90

⇒ __**32 + 96**__ - 64 = 90

⇒ __**128 - 64**__ = 90

⇒ 64 ≠ 90

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : + and –

Given equation : 32 + 24 × 4 ÷ 16 – 64 = 90

After interchanging the symbols in given equation the equation is as follows : 32 - 24 × 4 ÷ 16 + 64 = 90

⇒ 32 - 24 × __**4 ÷ 16**__ + 64 = 90

⇒ 32 - __**24 × 0.25**__ + 64 = 90

⇒ __**32**__ - 6 __**+ 64**__ = 90

⇒ __**96**____** - 6**__ = 90

**⇒ 90 = 90**

**LHS = RHS**

Hence, the correct answer is **"+ and –".**

questions.question:
If ‘A’ denotes ‘addition’, ‘B’ denotes ‘multiplication’, ‘C’ denotes ‘subtraction’ and ‘D’ denotes ‘division’, then what will be the value of the following expression?

8 B (4 A 5) C (99 A 27) D 14 A 5 B (112 D 16)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4e96b135d06590ae0ae7e406426d00c4343bd6f2def4b9b87997baafdb464871.png] 

Given :-

 
 

 **Alphabets**
 **Symbols**
 
 

 A
 +
 
 

 B
 × 
 
 

 C
 -
 
 

 D
 ÷ 
 
 

Given expression is : 8 B (4 A 5) C (99 A 27) D 14 A 5 B (112 D 16)

After replacing the alphabets with symbols the expression is as follows : 8 × (4 + 5) - (99 + 27) ÷ 14 + 5 × (112 ÷ 16)

= 8 × __**(4 + 5)**__ - __**(99 + 27)**__ ÷ 14 + 5 × __**(112 ÷ 16)**__

= 8 × 9 - __**126 ÷ 14**__ + 5 × 7

= __**8 × 9**__ - 9 + __**5 × 7**__

= __**72**__ - 9 __**+ 35**__

= __**107 - 9**__

= **98**

Hence, the correct answer is **"98".**

questions.question:
‘A % B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

‘A $ B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’.

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the son of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

If ‘R % T & Z $ S @ V @ C % Y’, then which of the following statements is NOT correct?

options.text: C is the paternal grandmother of Z.
T is the mother of S.
T is the daughter of C.
V is the father of Z.

questions.solution:
Preparing the family tree using the following symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/599c31a3b6c5ca06ce1787b908a152975e0540fada6e60ee63a4282f38f5a661.png] 

 ‘A % B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

‘A $ B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’.

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the son of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’.

 
 

 **Symbol**
 %
 $
 @
 &
 
 

 **Meaning**
 sister
 brother
 son
 mother
 
 

The given expression is :

‘R % T & Z $ S @ V @ C % Y’ → R is sister of T, T is mother of Z, Z is brother of S, S is son of V, V is the son of C, C is the sister of Y.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a6db76463cd9bd1395a7ae6eb187436a37b4f635810901f3e7fe748ed88e0c41.png] 

Option 1) : C is the paternal grandmother of Z → True (As T is mother of Z, Z is brother of S, S is son of V, V is the son of C so, C is the paternal grandmother of Z is true)

Option 2) : T is the mother of S → True (As T is mother of Z, Z is brother of S, S is son of V so, T is the mother of S is true)

Option 3) : T is the daughter of C → False (As T is mother of Z, Z is brother of S, S is son of V, V is the son of C so, **T is daughter-in-law of C** but given T is the daughter of C is false)

Option 4) : V is the father of Z → True (As T is mother of Z, Z is brother of S, S is son of V so, V is the father of Z is true)

∴ Here, 'T is the daughter of C' is not correct by following statements in given expression.

Hence, the correct answer is **"T is the daughter of C".**

Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some printers are coolers.

No cooler is a telephone.

All machines are telephones.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some printers are machines.

II. No machine is a cooler.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a21b03557e69d1f692735099b13c1a35a461296b0e105cd90a68d14b59f39ae8.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some printers are machines → False (As Some printers are coolers and All machines are telephones and No cooler is a telephone so, Some printers are machines is false)

II. No machine is a cooler → True (As All machines are telephones and No cooler is a telephone so, No machine is a cooler is true)

∴ Here, Only conclusion II is true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows".**

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series, will complete the series.

S P _ _ _ P S T S _ _ _ S P S _

options.text: T S S P T S S
P S S P P S S
P S T S P T T
S T S P S T T

questions.solution:
Given :- S P _ _ _ P S T S _ _ _ S P S _ 

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

1) T S S P T S S → S P **T**** S - S** P S T - S **P T S** - S P S **S**

2) P S S P P S S → S P **P S - S **P S T - S **P P S** - S P S **S**

3) P S T S P T T → S P **P S - T** P S T - S **S P T - **S P S **T**

4) S T S P S T T → S P **S T - S** P S T - S **P S T** - S P S **T**

 
• Here **'****SPST'** is repeated.
 
• Option (4) gives the pattern of :- S P **S T** - S P S T - S P S T - S P S T

Hence, the correct answer is** "S T S P S T T".**

questions.question: If 90% of a number is 621, what will be 50% of 20% of that number?
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

Given 90% of a number is 621

Let us consider number as 'A'.

⇒ (90/100) × A = 621

⇒ 0.9A = 621

⇒ A = 690

∴ The number is '690'.

Then 50% of 20% of that number is :

⇒ 50% = 0.5, 20% = 0.2

= 0.5 × 0.2 × 690

= 0.1 × 690

= 69

Hence, the correct answer is **"69".**
